description.text: Starter Set ex Fuecoco & Ampharos ex, one of three starter sets released on 20 January 2023, the day the Scarlet & Violet series began with the Scarlet ex and Violet ex expansions. Its deck pairs Fuecoco and its evolutions with Ampharos ex, a Stage 2 Pokémon with 330 HP whose second attack does 240 damage when two Energy are discarded from it. Each box held a ready-to-play 60-card deck with one Pokémon ex, damage counters and markers, a coin, a playmat, a rule book and a guide, and a promo pack with one card drawn at random from four: two suited to its deck and two that suit any of them, Cyclizar ex among them.
